relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 activates EP2 receptors to increase the expression of the voltage-dependent sodium channel Nav1.7 in TG neurons, leading to neuronal hyperexcitability

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: CFA injection in the TMJ increases COX2 expression and subsequent production of PGE2 by SGCs.

relationships.subject: IL-1beta
relationships.evidence_quote: Similar to PGE2, IL1β expressed by SGCs can increase Nav1.7 expression in TG neurons [25].

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: could cause the activation of the adjacent SGCs to release cytokines and chemokines

key_findings: Review: SGC COX2-PGE2-EP2 signaling raises Nav1.7 in trigeminal neurons in TMJ inflammation
Glial cells (SGCs, astrocytes, microglia) contribute to headache, TMD, dental pulp and head and neck cancer pain
